name: tft-tavern
description: w3i flag 0x4000 (Requires The Frozen Throne data). A tavern (ntav, version 1 in UnitData.slk) placed for Neutral Passive at (1280, 1024), far from the start, on the melee flat.w3x: the editor's save sets 0x4000 (we-drive 2026-11-17, branch fix-bugs-w3i). Inputs of this file: tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-melee-valid.mjs (its tft-* cases) into target/melee-valid/. Studio: lib/terrain/tftflag.ts through meleesave.ts, run by the map script's generation as on a save.

name: tft-creep
description: A creep of version 1 (nanb, Neutral Hostile): sets 0x4000.

name: tft-unit-v2
description: A unit of version 2 (sfoo, Reforged): sets 0x4000.

name: tft-unit-v0
description: The control: a unit of version 0 (nfrp) leaves 0x4000 off.

name: tft-item
description: An item of version 1 (shas) in war3mapUnits.doo: sets 0x4000.

name: tft-dest
description: A destructable of version 1 (LTbr, a barrel): leaves 0x4000 off (destructables don't count).

name: tft-doodad
description: A doodad of version 1 (ZPfw, no pathing): leaves 0x4000 off (doodads don't count).

name: tft-tavern-off
description: The tavern on the map with Melee cleared: the save puts Melee back on and sets 0x4000 (the two are independent).

name: tft-drop
description: A frog (nfrp, version 0) whose drop set holds an item of version 1 (shas): sets 0x4000.

name: tft-drop-random
description: The frog with a random item (YjI5: permanent, level 5) in its drop set: leaves 0x4000 off.

name: tft-clear
description: flat.w3x with 0x4000 already set and nothing of version 1 or 2 placed: the save clears it.

name: tft-inventory
description: A Paladin (Hpal, version 0) with shas (version 1) in inventory slot 0, nothing else of version 1 (branch we-batch-3).

name: tft-item-table
description: A war3map.w3i item table that nothing uses, its one drop set shas (version 1) (branch we-batch-3).

name: tft-dest-drop

name: tft-inventory-clear
description: tft-inventory's Paladin with 0x4000 already set and nothing else of version 1 (branch we-batch-3).

name: tft-item-table-clear
description: tft-item-table's table with 0x4000 already set (branch we-batch-3).

name: tft-dest-drop-v0
